candidates.description: This vector activates on fragments of Indic scripts, particularly Devanagari characters and vowel signs.
This vector represents characters, vowel signs, and consonant conjuncts from the Devanagari script used for writing various Indian languages.
This feature vector activates on various Hindi pronouns and inflections, along with unrelated character fragments from different scripts.
These tokens represent vowel signs, independent vowels, and common character combinations from the Devanagari script used for Indic languages.
These tokens represent common consonant-vowel conjuncts and characters in the Devanagari script used for writing Hindi and other Indian languages.
This vector represents subword fragments and character combinations commonly found in Hindi script.
This vector represents Devanagari vowel matras and dependent sign combinations attached to punctuation marks.
This feature vector activates on a random collection of sub-word tokens from Hindi script and numbers.
This vector activates for common consonant-vowel combinations and orthographic components in the Devanagari script.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel matras and punctuation marks used in Devanagari script.
